description: Common Ground update policy (docs/infrastructure/UPDATE-POLICY.md): nothing younger than 7 days (security fixes: 3 days), every image digest-pinned, nothing auto-merges. Runs as the Mend Renovate GitHub app.

prBodyNotes: Re-resolves every yarn.lock within the existing version ranges. Yarn's own `npmMinimalAgeGate: 1w` (.yarnrc.yml) applies to the re-resolution; Renovate's `minimumReleaseAge` does not cover lock file maintenance (docs/infrastructure/UPDATE-POLICY.md).

customManagers.description: Helper image of the SeaweedFS volume-merge script (a docker run, not a Dockerfile or compose file)
corepack, installed from the npm tarball in the Node-based Dockerfiles (Node >= 25 no longer bundles it)

packageRules.description: Major updates are opened only after approval on the Dependency Dashboard
The seven deferred majors (roadmap decision 7) are done by hand in waves M1-M4 — no Renovate PRs. Drop a name from this list once its wave is merged.
Frontend (root package.json): one weekly PR for all minor/patch updates
Backend (srv/): one weekly PR for all minor/patch updates
SDK workspaces: one weekly PR for all minor/patch updates
Hardhat toolchains (contracts/ and the dev chain image): one weekly PR for all minor/patch updates
mediasoup ships its worker binary through a sha256-pinned download; the backend image build fails until the pin is updated
prBodyNotes: Update `MEDIASOUP_VERSION` and the hashes in `docker/backend/fetch_mediasoup_worker.sh` in this PR (`tools/update-pins.sh mediasoup <version>` prints them) — `docker/backend/check_pinned_binaries.sh` fails the backend image build until they match.

packageRules.description: puppeteer is pinned to one Chrome for Testing build installed via a sha256-pinned download; the backend image build fails until the pin is updated
prBodyNotes: If puppeteer's Chrome revision changed, update `CHROME_VERSION` and `CHROME_SHA256` in `docker/backend/fetch_chrome.sh` in this PR (`tools/update-pins.sh chrome <version>` prints the sha256) — `docker/backend/check_pinned_binaries.sh` fails the backend image build until they match.

packageRules.description: Yarn (packageManager) is updated by hand: corepack's +sha512 hash and the pre-fetch in docker/node/Dockerfile must move together
corepack is verified against COREPACK_SHA512 next to COREPACK_VERSION; the image builds fail until the hash is updated
prBodyNotes: Update `COREPACK_SHA512` in all four Dockerfiles in this PR (`tools/update-pins.sh corepack <version>` prints it) — the `sha512sum -c` step fails the image builds until it matches.

packageRules.description: Docker base and service images: one weekly PR for digest refreshes and minor/patch versions
Images built locally from this repository's Dockerfiles (compose image: lines, FROM commonground/backend_stage_0): on no registry, nothing to look up
